Veteran Marathi theatre legend Vijaya Mehta passes away at 91

Vijaya Mehta, a renowned theatre director, actor, and producer in the Marathi theatre scene, passed away on Tuesday at the age of 91. She was known for her influential work that transformed Indian theatre. Her legacy will be remembered by those who knew her and worked with her.
